svg.title: abhishek kokadwar
svg.desc: A four-scene loop. First a terminal session typing out pipeline and evaluation results. Then GridPulse splitting a Kafka stream into a hot Postgres path and a cold Parquet path behind an event-time watermark. Then the MCP gateway subtracting a declared capability set from observed syscalls to build a seccomp filter. Then CIDRA reproducing a CI failure in a sandbox and refusing to propose a fix it could not verify.

g.text: data pipelines · backend · the boundaries between systems
ok gridpulse 42 meters · 19 buildings · sub-minute latency
53 runs · 100% tier-1/2 · zero false verified claims
a packet four minutes late is held by the watermark, not silently averaged in
the filter is what is left after subtracting the declaration from what the server actually did
84.6% runtime defence · 100% containment · 87.8% on MCPTox across 583 rows

text.tspan: the fix reproduced green in the sandbox, so it ships
it could not be verified, so it is not proposed at all

g.text: hot path buys freshness, cold path buys history, neither pays for the other
a capability claim is not a fact until the kernel agrees
an unverified fix is worse than no fix
